lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a regular grid-like configuration posterior to the gill slits, forming distinct horizontal rows and vertical columns relative to the body's midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice pattern where the circular blobs serve as nodes at each intersection point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin, with a sparse distribution concentrated primarily on the lower half of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear high-luminance markings resembling abrasions or scratches are visible on the anterior snout and head region. Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are attached to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin and the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct cluster of four remoras is visible trailing from the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
